title: Howell’s A Grammar of the Classical Arabic Language
text:
About this project
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم
Mortimer Sloper Howell (Wikipedia entry) published his A Grammar of the Classical Arabic Language from 1880–1911.
It has more than 4000 pages printed across 7 books. The scanned PDFs are hosted at: https://archive.org/details/howellarabicgrammar2013.
This Quarto book aims to make his work more navigable.
Here is a summary breakdown of the parts and sections into the individually bound books:
For links to the individual sections, I build upon the work done by Aasim Iqbal (جزاه الله خيرًا) published on his site and hosted at https://archive.org/details/AI2_reuploads2.

How to use this web-book
In order to use this web-book, first navigate to the chapter from the sidebar on the left. It will open a chapter page with two frames:

The frame on the left is an embedded PDF of the combined table of contents (ToC).
The frame on the right either:

Opens that chapter, if it has only one section.
Or it lists links to the sections contained in that chapter. Scroll through the ToC to determine your desired section number. And click on the link for your desired section number to open it in that frame. In order to go back to the clickable section list, click the back button on your browser.

Notes regarding the text

Numbers in square brackets in running text, for example “[402]”, are a cross-reference to that section number.
Howell’s own opinions are within brackets.
